propositions: Provider construction logic is currently scattered in runner.py via inline startswith branches, with no centralized place to answer how a provider is constructed for a given provider type.
The Anthropic client teardown uses a tuple return and finally-block cleanup that cannot be carried through pydantic-ai's infer_model provider_factory hook, which returns only a Provider.
A ProviderSession object must own the lifecycle of all constructed httpx.AsyncClient instances and close them via context-manager __exit__, whether run() returns normally or raises.
The per-provider builders must register with a ProviderSession registry so that run() obtains its provider through a single factory callable matching pydantic-ai's infer_model contract.
Existing tests importing _build_retrying_anthropic_model from runner.py must be updated to import from anthropic_model.py with no behavior change.
An unknown provider name must raise LLMConfigError listing registered providers, not a KeyError.
